proposed_comments.title: Make the thumbnail host click-through

confidence.rationale: WS_EX_NOACTIVATE prevents focus activation but does not suppress hit-testing; the display-only thumbnail host can therefore intercept clicks through transparent overlay regions.

proposed_comments.body:
### Make the thumbnail host click-through

**Severity:** `high`

`WS_EX_NOACTIVATE` stops this helper window from taking focus, but it does not make the window transparent to mouse hit-testing. Because `thumbHost` sits above the layered overlay, clicks that land on transparent overlay pixels can still be consumed by the host instead of reaching the window underneath. Add `WS_DISABLED` to the host style (or otherwise explicitly suppress hit-testing) so the display-only thumbnail surface remains click-through.

proposed_comments.title: Bound snapshot memory and preserve a fallback preview

confidence.rationale: The current path retains native-resolution PrintWindow bitmaps for every visible slot and skips DWM registration even when capture returns null, creating both a large-memory path and an empty-preview failure mode.

proposed_comments.body:
### Bound snapshot memory and preserve a fallback preview

**Severity:** `high`

The static-preview path stores each window capture at native client resolution until the overlay closes, so several 4K windows can consume hundreds of megabytes even though each card only displays a small preview. Downsample/crop the capture to the destination preview rectangle immediately and retain only that bitmap; if `PrintWindow` fails, leave the slot aligned but continue to register a live DWM thumbnail so protected or GPU-exclusive windows do not render as an empty acrylic hole.

proposed_comments.title: Composite the page indicator over the panel

confidence.rationale: The footer currently uses the opaque tile-header text path against the translucent panel, and the backing pixels must be flushed before the direct alpha-compositing path reads them.

proposed_comments.body:
### Composite the page indicator over the panel

**Severity:** `medium`

The page indicator is drawn over the translucent panel, but this call still uses the opaque tile-header path, which paints a solid dark rectangle across the footer. Use a transparent-background text path that alpha-composites glyph coverage onto the existing pixels, and flush pending GDI+ drawing before reading those pixels; otherwise the direct buffer access can blend against stale data or be overwritten by the later flush.
